validity.researcher_notes: TWO spec issues on this row, combined here (validity keys on segment_name+concern_type, so both 'spec' findings are recorded together): (1) AGGREGATE-VS-SEGMENT ON CAPACITY -- RF decree 816-r item 340 names ONE line -- 'Магистральный газопровод УКПГ Пеляткинского ГКМ - УКПГ Мессояхского ГМ' -- without distinguishing nitka I from nitka II, and states ONE design-capacity figure, 'проектный объем транспортировки газа - 1,8 млрд. куб. метров в год' (1.8 bcm/y). GEM records this same 1.80 bcm/y on BOTH P6683 (I) and P6684 (II). Could not find a document breaking capacity out per string, so cannot say whether each string is independently rated 1.8 bcm/y (plausible for Arctic redundant-pipe design, where a parallel backup string is each rated to carry full flow) or whether 1.8 bcm/y is the COMBINED capacity of both strings (which would mean each row overstates its own segment). Not changing the value absent evidence either way; a researcher with access to Norilsktransgaz's FAS filings (raskrytie-informatsii > uslugi-po-transportirovke-gaza-po-truboprovodam, 2023-2026 folders hold per-year .xls transport-volume data, not opened this lean pass) could settle it. (2) INVALID LENGTH CITATION -- the existing Length [ref] (http://www.gorod-dudinka.ru/download/genplan/genplan.pdf) does not support 117 km. Full-text read of the ~21,000-line PDF: zero mentions of Мессояха, Северо/Южно-Соленинское, ГКМ, конденсатопровод, Норильсктрансгаз, or нитка anywhere; the only Pelyatka-adjacent entries are an unrelated winter road (Тухард-Пелятка-Дудинка-Носок, 63.17 km) and an unrelated village gasification distribution line (п. Пелятка - п. Носок - г. Дудинка, 190 km). ResearcherNotes says the figure was proxied from a parallel NGL pipeline's length per this PDF, but that NGL line is not in the document at all -- reads as a citation/sourcing error, not a stale-but-real source. Independent search found no document stating a discrete length for the Pelyatka-Messoyakha I or II string; only SYSTEM aggregates (1202 km for all 5 strings of both sections combined; 300 km field-to-Norilsk) or the unrelated Messoyakha-Norilsk II string (118 km, a different family/PID) turned up. See the paired fills[] UNRESOLVED record for the full source list checked.
